groups.canonical_name: Slow EV adoption regulatory compliance cost
groups.definition: Risk that slower-than-expected EV adoption forces costly measures such as regulatory credit purchases to meet ZEV and fuel economy rules.

groups.canonical_name: Slow EV demand and investment losses
groups.definition: Risk that weaker-than-expected electric vehicle demand, driven by policy and incentive changes, leads to program cuts, impairments and unrecouped EV investments.
Risk that moderating Chinese economic growth reduces vehicle production and demand in China, lowering sales.
